args.data: This Meetings tab tracks expert calls and the meeting calendar for corporate access activity. The Expert Calls widget (corporate_access_meeting_notes_meetings_expert_calls) logs expert network engagements, topics, attendees, and status, while the Meeting Calendar widget (corporate_access_meeting_notes_meetings_meeting_calendar) tracks scheduled company meetings and upcoming access metrics. Use both together to monitor upcoming and completed expert calls alongside the broader meeting calendar for compliance and research follow-up.
